description: Reads what the business offers, as the app shows it: whatYouOffer (Brand's What you offer: the products, services and initiatives the read of its pages found), sell (Sell's ways in: its plans, services and products with their prices), and removed (what the owner took off). The same offering can be named differently in each list. Read it before offering_remove or offering_restore; the products' own pictures and details are on Brand (place_open brand).

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
